x = np.empty((n,3))
x[:,0]=r.binomial(1,c["p_w1"],n)
x[:,1]=r.binomial(1,c["p_w2"],n)
x[:,2]=r.binomial(1,c["p_w3_intercept"]+c["p_w3_slope"]*(x[:,0]+x[:,1]))
a=r.binomial(1,expit(c["treatment_intercept"]+c["treatment_w_sum"]*x.sum(1)+c["treatment_w1w2"]*x[:,0]*x[:,1]))
m=r.binomial(1,expit(c["m_w1"]*x[:,0]+c["m_w2"]*x[:,1]+c["m_a"]*a+c["m_aw2"]*a*x[:,1]))[:,None]
y=r.binomial(1,expit((c["y_a"]*a+c["y_m"]*m[:,0])/(x.sum(1)+c["y_denominator_intercept"])))
return x,a,m,y,["binary"],["binary"]*3,"binary"

observed_variables.name: Y
observed_variables.description: Observed outcome; not an oracle target

mechanism.sampling: IID observations at a fixed structural configuration; separate mechanism and observation seeds.
assumptions: Independent exogenous structural errors and iid units conditional on fixed configuration.
No treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounder remains in the adapted SEM.
Causal identification additionally requires consistency, exchangeability/cross-world conditions and treatment/mediator support; treatment randomization alone is insufficient.

estimand.name: NIE
estimand.definition: NIE = E[Y(1,M(1))-Y(1,M(0))] in the adapted fixed-SEM superpopulation, jointly intervening on the complete mediator vector.

truth.expression: NIE = E[Y(1,M(1))-Y(1,M(0))] in the adapted fixed-SEM superpopulation, jointly intervening on the complete mediator vector.
truth.derivation: exact_finite_enumeration: Enumerate all eight baseline states; multiply the mediator probability contrast by the treatment-1 outcome-mean contrast between mediator values.

adaptations: Remove Z structurally: set m_z, m_az, y_z and y_az to zero. Recompute natural NIE1, replacing the source interventional indirect-effect target.
New complete-data superpopulation NIE1 target; original records/estimands are retained separately.
